name: Lust or Heaven
detailed_description:
This novella will immerse you in the life of an ordinary, introverted guy named Nathan, who has been passionate about drawing since childhood. The story begins at university, where the hero finds himself captivated by a mysterious girl during one of his classes, unable to tear his gaze away from her. He feels an intense attraction but struggles to find the courage to introduce himself.

One evening, at a party hosted by a friend, something extraordinary happens that will change his life forever. This encounter marks the beginning of an exciting journey, where you will have the opportunity to decide the hero's fate by making choices in the game. Will Nathan find reciprocation? Or will he plunge into a whirlwind of fiery passions? Only your actions will determine how the main character's story unfolds.
